scope: First 10 true unresolved records after excluding 12 Germany duplicate links

decisions.name: Engelsley
decisions.review: Exact Engelsley identity in Altenahr; OSM natural=peak and GeoNames 2930214 identify the same named landform. Runtime category rock is intentionally preserved rather than silently recategorized.

decisions.name: Saffenburg-Blick
decisions.reason: Several distinct viewpoints around Mayschoss are described as a view toward/from Saffenburg; no single exact OSM identity can be selected safely from the current source name alone.

decisions.name: Burgruine Falkenstein Allgäu
decisions.review: Exact Falkenstein castle ruin at Pfronten in Ostallgaeu; correct regional context and castle identity.

decisions.name: Gaisalpsee
decisions.review: Matched to Unterer Gaisalpsee/Geisalpsee near Oberstdorf. OSM way 25794128 is natural=water; the upper lake is separately named Oberer Gaisalpsee, so the unqualified source name is assigned to the lower/main Gaisalpsee.

decisions.name: Hochvogel
decisions.review: Correct 2592 m Hochvogel in the Allgaeu/Lechtal context; exact OSM peak and GeoNames 2775914. Border summit retained in Germany catalog context; lower homonymous peaks were explicitly rejected.

decisions.name: Scheidegger Wasserfälle
decisions.review: Exact named Scheidegger Wasserfaelle feature in Scheidegg. Information-sign nodes nearby were not used.

decisions.name: Schlappoldkopf
decisions.review: Exact Schlappoltkopf peak; Schlappoldkopf is a documented alternate spelling. The summit lies on the Bavaria/Vorarlberg border and is valid in the Allgaeu/Fellhorn source context.

decisions.name: Marienbrücke
decisions.review: Exact Marienbruecke footbridge over the Poellat near Neuschwanstein; OSM way 41720896. Runtime category nature is preserved as existing project taxonomy.

decisions.name: Pöllatschlucht
decisions.review: Representative canonical point inside Poellatschlucht: the named Poellatfall directly below Marienbruecke. Official Schwangau/LfU context confirms this feature is within the gorge; source is deliberately marked representative, not an entrance.

decisions.name: Säuling
decisions.review: Exact 2047 m Saeuling summit; OSM node 495075191 and GeoNames 2841123. Border mountain belongs to both Germany and Austria contexts; Germany catalog assignment is preserved.
